metadata.title: Retro Group Portrait with Neon Script

retrievalProfile.description: A grainy, warm-toned group portrait of five men with a large, glowing neon-style script logo overlaid across the upper half.
excludeWhen: minimalist or flat design is requested
the subject is a single person

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of five men with varying facial hair and hairstyles, posed closely together against a neutral, slightly textured background. The image is characterized by a warm, desaturated color palette and a prominent, glowing orange-red neon script that spans the width of the frame behind the central figure.
coreVisualRelationships: Central bearded figure as the primary visual anchor
Neon script overlapping the background and partially obscured by the subjects
Tight, triangular composition of the group members
Wide-spaced sans-serif text at the very top edge
coreInvariants: Grainy film texture across the entire image
Glowing orange-red neon tube effect for the script lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five men arranged in a tight cluster, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame; the central figure is slightly larger and more forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central man with crossed arms and a full beard.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing neon script, move down to the central figure, then circulate through the surrounding faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, mostly confined to the upper corners around the neon script.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (skin tones and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black (hair and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the skin tones; the neon script provides the only high-saturation element.

letterConstructionRules: Main script mimics a continuous neon tube with rounded ends
Script features a long horizontal underline that extends from the final letter
Top text is a wide-tracked, monolinear sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial capital letter of the script is oversized and encircles part of the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, glowing script and a rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: To match the tubular, glowing aesthetic of the central logo.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked feel of the top display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, warm-toned 1970s film photograph of five bearded men posed closely together, shirtless, against a neutral grey-beige background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a large, glowing orange-red neon script logo in the upper center and a wide-tracked sans-serif title at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Does the script have a neon glow?
Is the top text widely spaced?
Are the colors warm and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand names or existing band logos
Ensure the script is a custom-drawn neon path rather than a standard font
postGenerationChecks: Check for 70s-appropriate hairstyles and facial hair
Verify the neon script appears to be 'behind' the subjects' heads
Ensure the top text is perfectly aligned and justified
Confirm the overall color palette is cohesive and warm
